Part.name: Relikt side box
Part.description: Relikt - modular side box (game proxy) Resize X to add whole cells along the length (1 to 8); the height is fixed at two rows. 270 x 150 mm per cell, 136 mm deep, slotted mounting lip on the top edge and a hinge strip. Each cell has its own formed plate and a finite reactive charge. Plates: 1 | one 13 mm active plate per cell, inclined 25 degrees APFSDS at 60°: 19.2% less pen. (L/D 30) HEAT at 60°: 54.6% less pen. Tandem: no guaranteed protection Used on: T-90M, T-80BVM side skirts (family) Mount: incoming fire toward local +X (lengthwise) Mass and cost scale with paid cell area only, never depth
